specs.Compatible Devices: Gaming Console, Karaoke Machine, Laptop, MP3 Player, Smartphone, Tablet, Television

features: [Powerful 2.1 Channel Sound]: The IKALL 40 Watt Powerful Base Sound Home Theatre System delivers immersive audio with deep bass and clear highs, perfect for movies, music, and gaming.
[Bluetooth & Wired Connectivity]: Enjoy seamless streaming via Bluetooth or connect directly with a wired option; compatible with TVs, smartphones, tablets, and more.
[Enhanced Bass with Subwoofer]: Experience rich, room-filling sound with the powerful subwoofer, designed to enhance your entertainment experience.
[Sleek & Modern Design]: The IKALL Home Theatre System combines a stylish design with easy setup, making it a perfect addition to any living room or entertainment space.
[Convenient Remote Control]: Easily manage your audio settings with the included remote control, allowing you to adjust volume, bass, and more from the comfort of your couch.
